mechanism_target: ### Dropping a Vector Drops Its Elements Like any other `struct`, a vector is freed when it goes out of scope, as annotated in Listing 8-4. ```rust {{#rustdoc_include ../listings/ch08-common-collections/listing-08-04/src/main.rs:here}} ``` Listing 8-4: Showing where the vector and its elements are dropped When the vector gets dropped, all of its contents are also dropped, meaning those integers it holds will be cleaned up. This may seem like a straightforward point but can get a bit more complicated when you start to introduce references to the elements of the vector. Let’s tackle that next!
